title: OnlyC418 Music
description: Adds all C418 tracks to Minecraft while removing Lena Raine's and other modern soundtrack additions, bringing back the classic nostalgic experience.
body:
Tired of hearing Minecraft's newer soundtrack instead of the nostalgic and unforgettable music of C418? Only C418 Music restores the classic atmosphere by replacing modern tracks with the legendary soundtrack that defined Minecraft for millions of players.

Relive the golden era of Minecraft with an expanded collection of C418's music from both Volume Alpha and Volume Beta, carefully integrated throughout the game to create a rich and varied survival experience.

Features:
Replaces modern Minecraft music with C418's soundtrack.
Includes over 50 C418 tracks from Minecraft's classic albums.
Greatly expands music variety in Survival mode.
Restores iconic menu, exploration, creative, End, and ambient tracks.
Preserves the nostalgic atmosphere of classic Minecraft.
Compatible with Minecraft 1.21.1 resource packs.

Whether you're exploring caves, building your base, or simply watching the sunset, experience Minecraft the way you remember it: with the timeless music of C418.
